title: Register as mentee with valid data
preconditions: None
steps: POST /auth/register with valid email, password, role=mentee, name
expected_result: 201; userId returned; OTP generated and emailed

title: Register as mentor with valid data and CV
preconditions: None
steps: POST /auth/register with role=mentor, linkedinUrl, hourlyRate, cv object
expected_result: 201; userId returned; MentorProfile created with cv/hourlyRate; auto-approved

title: Register with duplicate verified email
preconditions: An account exists with this email and isEmailVerified=true
expected_result: 409 Email already registered

title: Register with duplicate unverified email
preconditions: An account exists with this email and isEmailVerified=false
expected_result: 200/201; new OTP generated and resent; no duplicate user created

title: Register with missing required fields
preconditions: None
expected_result: 400 Email, password, and role are required

title: Register with invalid role
preconditions: None
expected_result: 400 Role must be mentee or mentor

title: Verify OTP with correct code
preconditions: A user has registered and has a pending OTP
steps: POST /auth/verify-otp with userId and correct otp
expected_result: 200; accessToken and user returned; refresh cookie set

title: Verify OTP with incorrect code
preconditions: A user has a pending OTP
expected_result: 400 invalid/expired OTP message

title: Verify OTP with expired code
preconditions: A user's OTP has expired (>10 minutes old)
expected_result: 400 invalid/expired OTP message

title: Resend OTP
preconditions: A user has an unverified account
expected_result: 200; new OTP generated and emailed

title: Login with valid verified credentials
preconditions: A verified user account exists
expected_result: 200; accessToken and user returned

title: Login with unverified account
preconditions: An unverified user account exists
expected_result: 403; userId returned so client can jump to OTP screen; new OTP sent

title: Login with wrong password
preconditions: A verified user account exists
expected_result: 401 Invalid email or password

title: Login with non-existent email
preconditions: None
steps: POST /auth/login with an email that has no account
expected_result: 401 Invalid email or password (no user-existence leak)

title: Refresh access token with valid refresh cookie
preconditions: User is logged in and holds a valid refresh cookie
expected_result: 200; new accessToken returned; refresh token rotated

title: Refresh with missing or invalid cookie
preconditions: No refresh cookie present, or an invalid one
expected_result: 401 No/invalid refresh token provided

title: Logout revokes the current device's refresh token
preconditions: User is logged in
steps: POST /auth/logout, then attempt POST /auth/refresh with the old cookie
expected_result: Logout 200; the old refresh token then fails to reissue a new access token

title: Forgot password with existing email
preconditions: An account exists with this email
expected_result: 200; generic confirmation message; reset email sent

title: Forgot password with non-existent email
preconditions: None
expected_result: 200; identical generic message (does not reveal whether the email exists)

title: Reset password with valid token
preconditions: A valid password-reset token exists for a user
expected_result: 200; password changed; all existing refresh tokens invalidated (forced logout everywhere)

title: Reset password with expired or invalid token
preconditions: A reset token that is invalid or expired
expected_result: 400 Invalid or expired reset token

title: GET /auth/me without a token
preconditions: No Authorization header
expected_result: 401 Access denied. No token provided.

title: GET /auth/me with a valid token
preconditions: User is logged in
expected_result: 200; user returned with role profile populated (mentorProfile or menteeProfile)

title: Google OAuth signup for a brand-new user
preconditions: No existing account with the Google email
steps: Complete Google OAuth flow with a new Google account
expected_result: New User created with role=mentee, isEmailVerified=true, authProvider=google; no mentee profile created yet

title: Google OAuth login links an existing manually-registered account
preconditions: A local account exists with the same email, no googleId set
steps: Complete Google OAuth flow with that email
expected_result: Existing user's googleId is linked; isEmailVerified set true; logged in

title: Update own shared profile fields
preconditions: User is logged in

expected_result: 200; fields updated

title: Attempt to update role-specific fields via /user/profile
preconditions: User is logged in as mentor
steps: PATCH /user/profile with skills/hourlyRate in the body
expected_result: 200; only shared fields accepted, role-specific fields silently ignored (must be updated via /mentor-profiles)

title: Change password with correct current password
preconditions: User is logged in
steps: POST /user/change-password with correct currentPassword and a valid newPassword
expected_result: 200; password changed

title: Change password with incorrect current password
preconditions: User is logged in
expected_result: 401 Current password is incorrect

title: Delete own account
preconditions: User is logged in
expected_result: 200; User document and linked role profile (MentorProfile/MenteeProfileFlat) both deleted

expected_result: 200; list of approved mentors returned

preconditions: None
expected_result: 200; list of mentors returned (recommendation seam)

expected_result: 200; single mentor's public profile returned

title: View a mentor profile with an invalid id
preconditions: None
expected_result: 404 Mentor not found

title: Build mentor profile from CV
preconditions: Mentor is logged in and has an uploaded CV
expected_result: 200; skills/experience/company/title/industry extracted and saved to MentorProfile; isProfileComplete set true

title: Non-mentor attempts to build a mentor profile
preconditions: A mentee is logged in
expected_result: 403 Access denied. Required role: mentor

title: Upload a CV file for an existing mentor
preconditions: Mentor is logged in
expected_result: 200/201; CV stored on MentorProfile.cv

title: Extract skills/experience/company from a LinkedIn Save-to-PDF export

expected_result: skills, experience (years), and company are populated on MentorProfile

title: Education spanning multiple lines is correctly extracted (regression)
preconditions: CV text has degree, institution, and year on three separate lines
expected_result: education array includes the degree line, matched via the +/-1 line context window

title: Company extraction does not bleed across unrelated lines (regression)
preconditions: CV text has capitalized words spanning multiple unrelated lines near a company-suffix keyword
expected_result: Extracted company name is a single clean company string, not a multi-line concatenation

title: Title and industry are inferred from the CV headline (regression)
preconditions: CV text has a professional-title line near the top (e.g. Senior Software Engineer)
expected_result: MentorProfile.title and MentorProfile.industry are populated (previously always null)

title: Upload and parse a DOCX CV
preconditions: Mentor uploads a .docx CV with no client-side parsedText
expected_result: Server downloads and parses via mammoth; skills/experience extracted

title: Extraction still succeeds when Cloudinary download fails
preconditions: cv.parsedText is cached from the browser but cv.url returns 401/403 from Cloudinary
expected_result: Cached parsedText is used instead of re-downloading; extraction still succeeds

title: Build proceeds when no CV was ever provided
preconditions: Mentor has no cv object on their profile
expected_result: 200; build completes non-blocking with empty/partial results; onboarding is not blocked

title: Start a Python interview session
preconditions: Mentee app is pointed at the AI_interviewer service
expected_result: 200; session_id and opening_message returned

title: Complete an interview and produce a cleaned profile
preconditions: A session is in progress
steps: Answer all interview questions until is_complete=true
expected_result: Mentee_Profiles document created/updated, keyed by session_id, including cleaned_* fields

title: Link a completed interview session to the logged-in mentee
preconditions: Mentee is logged in; a completed session_id exists and is unlinked

title: Link with a missing sessionId
preconditions: Mentee is logged in
expected_result: 400 sessionId is required

title: Link with a sessionId that does not exist
preconditions: Mentee is logged in
expected_result: 404 Interview session not found

title: Link a session already linked to a different account
preconditions: A completed session is already linked to another user's userId
steps: POST /api/interview with that sessionId, logged in as a different mentee
expected_result: 409 already linked to a different account

title: Frontend calls the real link endpoint, not the removed one (regression)
preconditions: Mentee completes the interview in the UI
steps: Complete the interview via the frontend and observe the network call
expected_result: Frontend calls POST /api/interview (not the nonexistent /api/interview/complete-ai); no 404 in the flow

title: Fetch own linked interview profile
preconditions: Mentee has completed and linked an interview
expected_result: 200; profile returned, resolved by userId

title: Signup LinkedIn URL is copied onto the profile at link time

expected_result: Mentee_Profiles.linkedinUrl is set from User.linkedinUrl as a fallback

title: List all mentors and mentees

expected_result: 200; list of mentor and mentee users returned

title: Filter user list by role
preconditions: Admin is logged in
expected_result: 200; only mentors returned

title: Non-admin attempts to list users
preconditions: A mentee or mentor is logged in
expected_result: 403 Access denied. Required role: admin

title: Approve a mentor
preconditions: Admin is logged in; a mentor exists
expected_result: 200; MentorProfile.status=approved, isApproved=true, approvedAt/approvedBy set

title: Reject a mentor with a reason
preconditions: Admin is logged in; a mentor exists
expected_result: 200; MentorProfile.status=rejected, rejectionReason saved

title: Delete a user
preconditions: Admin is logged in; a target user exists
expected_result: 200; user and their role profile (MentorProfile/MenteeProfileFlat) deleted

expected_result: 400 You cannot delete your own admin account here

steps: GET /admin/users, then view a mentee's detail in the admin UI

title: Create a slot in the past

expected_result: 400 Cannot create a slot in the past

title: Create a slot overlapping an existing one

expected_result: 409 already have a slot configured for this day/time

title: Guest attempts to create a slot
preconditions: No authentication
expected_result: 401 Access denied. No token provided.

expected_result: 403 Not your slot

title: Book a slot that was just booked by someone else

title: A participant views only their own payments
